entities.summary: Guido Baldo Bonarelli (b. 1564-01-04, Pesaro) was a journalist or media commentator of the Early Modern period, marked by exploration, reformation, and the rise of nation-states, active in Pesaro. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
